name: Modern and Historical Arms and Armor

items.name: Heavy Flashlight
items.notes: Functions as a durable flashlight when not used as an improvised weapon.

items.name: Collapsible Baton
items.notes: A compact impact weapon intended for control rather than cutting.

items.name: Riot Baton
items.notes: Longer and more visible than a collapsible baton.

items.name: Combat or Utility Knife
items.notes: Also provides ordinary cutting and field-tool permission.

items.name: Machete
items.notes: Also clears ordinary vegetation and light material.

items.name: Breaching Axe
items.notes: A rescue and forced-entry tool capable of severe injury.

items.name: Sledgehammer
items.notes: Severe crushing damage; poorly suited to confined or reactive fighting.

items.name: Conducted-Energy Weapon
items.notes: Armor designed to insulate electrical contact may add its rating normally.

items.name: Irritant Spray
items.effect: On a hit, the target tests Resilience + Composure against 2 successes. Failure removes its Reaction and imposes -2 dice on sight-dependent actions until it spends a Standard Action washing, sealing, or otherwise clearing the irritant.

items.name: Beanbag Shotgun
items.notes: At Adjacent range the Moderator may treat obviously unsafe use as Lethal.

items.name: Compact Pistol
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Easy to carry and hide; limited practical range.

items.name: Service Pistol
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: The ordinary baseline defensive sidearm.

items.name: Heavy Pistol
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Higher damage at the cost of control and concealment.

items.name: Machine Pistol
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Compact automatic fire rapidly exhausts ammunition.

items.name: Submachine Gun
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Optimized for close quarters and controllable bursts.

items.name: Personal Defense Weapon
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Compact ammunition designed to defeat light protection.

items.name: Pump Shotgun
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: May load specialized ammunition when available.

items.name: Breaching Shotgun
items.notes: Designed for locks and hinges; exceptionally dangerous at close range.

items.name: Carbine
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Compact rifle suitable for vehicles and interior spaces.

items.name: Assault Rifle
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: General-purpose military rifle.

items.name: Battle Rifle
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Full-power rifle ammunition increases damage and recoil.

items.name: Designated Marksman Rifle
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Built for deliberate fire beyond ordinary carbine range.

items.name: Precision Rifle
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Requires position and time to exploit its accuracy.

items.name: Light Machine Gun
items.damageType: Lethal to living targets; normally Non-Lethal/Bashing to Vampires
items.notes: Sustained automatic support weapon.

items.name: General-Purpose Machine Gun
items.notes: Normally crew-served, mounted, or fired from a prepared position.

items.name: Anti-Materiel Rifle
items.damageType: Lethal; may remain Lethal against Vampires and other targets when explicitly rated
items.notes: Designed for equipment, barriers, and lightly armored targets.

items.name: Grenade Launcher
items.notes: Ammunition type may replace damage with smoke, irritant, light, or another explicit payload.

items.name: Shoulder-Fired Anti-Armor Rocket
items.notes: A disposable or single-loaded anti-vehicle weapon.

items.name: Fragmentation Grenade
items.notes: Cover and substantial barriers apply normally.

items.name: Stun Grenade
items.notes: Designed to overwhelm senses rather than penetrate protection.

items.name: Smoke Grenade
items.effect: Creates Substantial Concealment in a 5-meter radius for three rounds or until dispersed by strong ventilation.

items.name: Portable Flamethrower
items.notes: Ordinary flame is not automatically Aggravated; exact supernatural vulnerabilities may change that.

items.name: Modern Hunting Bow
items.notes: Quiet compared with firearms and dependent on recoverable arrows.

items.name: Modern Crossbow
items.notes: Mechanically powerful but slow to reload.

items.name: Reinforced Clothing
items.notes: Cut-resistant, impact-resistant, or discreetly reinforced garments.

items.name: Soft Ballistic Vest
items.notes: Flexible protection against common handgun threats and fragments.

items.name: Concealed Plate Vest
items.notes: More protective than soft armor but less comfortable and less flexible.

items.name: Plate Carrier
items.notes: Visible hard armor intended for direct combat.

items.name: Riot Armor
items.notes: Includes blunt-impact protection and hard limb guards.

items.name: Ballistic Helmet
items.stacking: Adds 1 Armor die against Blast, falling debris, and attacks explicitly targeting the head; it stacks with one worn armor item for those attacks only.

items.name: Ballistic Shield
items.effect: While braced as a Standard Action, the shield also provides Substantial Cover to its wielder and Partial Cover to one adjacent ally.

items.name: Bomb-Disposal Suit
items.notes: Designed for fragments and blast overpressure, not agile combat.

items.name: Fire-Entry Suit
items.effect: Adds 3 dice to resist ordinary environmental heat and flame. It does not resist supernatural or Aggravated fire unless explicitly modified.

items.name: Hazardous-Material Suit
items.effect: When sealed with a working respirator, adds 3 dice against ordinary chemical, biological, and particulate exposure. Tears or punctures suppress this benefit until patched.

items.name: Tactical Environmental Suit
items.effect: Provides six hours of filtered air and protection from ordinary contamination, severe weather, and short immersion. It is not vacuum-rated.

items.name: Industrial Powered Exoskeleton
items.effect: While powered, increase effective Carry by 4 and ignore the first 2 Load above Carry. It grants no bonus to attack or damage unless separately weaponized.

items.name: World War I Service Revolver
items.notes: Rugged sidearm with limited capacity.

items.name: World War I Bolt-Action Rifle
items.notes: The standard long-range infantry weapon of the period.

items.name: Trench Shotgun
items.notes: Particularly effective in confined fighting.

items.name: Rifle Bayonet
items.notes: When fixed to a rifle, the combined weapon has Load 3 and requires two hands.

items.name: Trench Club
items.notes: A simple close-quarters impact weapon.

items.name: World War I Light Machine Gun
items.notes: Heavy, mechanically demanding, and normally used from support.

items.name: Stick Grenade
items.notes: An early hand grenade with a distinct throwing handle.

items.name: World War I Steel Helmet
items.stacking: Adds 1 Armor die against Blast, falling debris, and head-targeted attacks; stacks with one worn armor item for those attacks only.

items.name: World War II Service Pistol
items.notes: Representative military sidearm of the period.

items.name: World War II Semi-Automatic Rifle
items.notes: Faster follow-up fire than a bolt-action rifle without full automatic operation.

items.name: World War II Sniper Rifle
items.notes: A selected and optically equipped service rifle.

items.name: World War II Submachine Gun
items.notes: Simple close-range automatic weapon.

items.name: World War II Light Machine Gun
items.notes: Squad-level automatic support weapon.

items.name: World War II Heavy Machine Gun
items.notes: Crew-served or vehicle-mounted sustained-fire weapon.

items.name: World War II Flamethrower
items.notes: Bulky fuel system and extreme psychological impact.

items.name: World War II Anti-Tank Launcher
items.notes: Primitive by later standards but devastating against personnel and light structures.

items.name: World War II Fragmentation Grenade
items.notes: Representative hand grenade of the period.

items.name: World War II Flak Vest
items.limitation: Against ordinary direct firearm attacks, treat Armor Rating as 1. Use the full rating against Blast, fragments, and falling debris.

items.name: Dagger
items.notes: A weapon and ordinary utility blade.

items.name: Arming Sword
items.notes: Balanced one-handed sword.

items.name: Longsword
items.notes: Can be used one-handed at -1 attack die.

items.name: Greatsword
items.notes: Large cutting weapon requiring room and commitment.

items.name: Spear
items.notes: May be thrown with Finesse + Athletics at Short range for the same damage.

items.name: Halberd
items.notes: Polearm combining hook, spike, and cutting head.

items.name: Hand Axe
items.notes: May be thrown at Short range with Finesse + Athletics.

items.name: Battle Axe
items.notes: Heavy cutting weapon.

items.name: Mace
items.notes: Concentrated impact effective against rigid armor.

items.name: Warhammer
items.notes: Narrow striking surfaces defeat armor at the cost of broad cutting power.

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.notes: Simple, flexible, and effective control weapon.

items.name: Shortbow
items.notes: Compact bow suitable for mobile use.

items.name: Longbow
items.notes: Requires strength, training, and space to draw.

items.name: Crossbow
items.notes: Easier to hold ready than a bow but slow to reload.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.notes: Often requires a mechanical spanning method.

items.name: Sling
items.notes: Dense or edged ammunition may deal Lethal damage when explicitly available.

items.name: Padded Armor
items.notes: Layered textile protection.

items.name: Hardened Leather Armor
items.notes: Light rigid protection with limited coverage.

items.name: Mail Armor
items.notes: Strong against cuts and weaker against concentrated impact.

items.name: Brigandine or Coat of Plates
items.notes: Overlapping plates fixed inside a textile or leather shell.

items.name: Full Plate Armor
items.notes: Exceptional historical protection requiring fitting and maintenance.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.notes: Adds Guard but not Armor.

items.name: Tower Shield
items.effect: When braced as a Standard Action, provides Substantial Cover to the wielder and Partial Cover to one adjacent ally.
